r22 verbatim (default seed=3407) on 20-task slice → 0/20 = 0%. Same recipe/seed/data as r22 (md5 confirmed identical). 4-sample r22-recipe distribution: 50/10/20/0 → mean=20%, σ≈21pp; CUDA non-determinism makes seed-fixed reruns diverge wildly. AC input_text COLLAPSED to 0% (was 37.5% in r22) — recipe is genuinely seed-fragile, not just slice-noisy

input_text x2 boost (500 rows) + 460 steps. AC offline DROPPED to 14.20% (-6.8 vs r29) — boost diluted click/scroll/navigate_back; input_text only moved 0→2.33%. Cancelled before AW. Conclusion: more input_text rows do NOT fix the structural emission problem. Pivoting to pure-a11y for r31

Pure-a11y AC-only (1500 rows, 400 steps, max_length=16384, no images) + new M3AA11Y harness (app inventory, deterministic history, executor feedback, no-op detection). 2/20 = 10% AW SR (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). open_app=96.77 (highest yet); pure-a11y emitted status=2% on AL despite no status training. First pure-a11y data point

Same r31 adapter + M3AA11Y harness PATCHES (no-op widening to scroll/input_text, status guard refusing complete on no-change, answer guard requiring open_app+click first, tolerant JSON parser, max_new_tokens 256→384). 1/20 = 5% AW SR — only OpenAppTaskEval succeeded; ClockStopWatchRunning regressed. Within σ≈7pp of r31's 10% but below best. Harness patches alone do NOT lift SR; variance dominates. Confirms scaffolding cannot compensate for unchanged adapter

Schema parity retrain (--harness-parity flag): AC training rows now emit indexed app inventory + det-history Step format matching M3AA11Y eval prompt. Same recipe as r31 (1500 AC-only rows, --text-only, max_length=16384, 400 steps). 2/20 = 10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Schema parity was format-neutral, NOT load-bearing. Offline AC type_match COLLAPSED 44.6→23.0 but input_text type_match SURGED 4.65→25.00 — model rebalanced action distribution toward AW-relevant verbs (click/input_text/open_app dominant; scroll/wait/navigate_back collapsed). Net AW result unchanged. Confirms hypothesis: harness investments + adapter alone cannot lift past r31 ceiling. Base model at capacity ceiling on (state,action) imitation. Pivoting to teacher distillation

Teacher distillation (Gemma 4 31B 4-bit) on 1500 harness-parity AC rows. INVALIDATED PRE-TRAIN by data analysis: (1) 96% of AC open_app rows target non-AW-inventory apps (Amazon/Khan Academy/Maps/Gmail/eBay/Vimeo etc., none in the harness 19-app set); (2) 281/329 erroneous teacher status emits were correct infeasibility refusals; (3) salvage step would force student to learn post-hoc rationalizations of actions teacher itself refused. Teacher fails on same classes as student (scroll 11%, navigate_back 2%, wait 3%, input_text 0% full-match) due to shared text-only-prompt deficiencies. Conclusion: data+harness problem, not model capacity. No student trained, no AW eval. Pivoting to r35 = rebuild train data with AW-app filter on AC + re-include AL

r35 AW-distribution data rebuild: AC filtered to AW-inventory open_app only (4727 dropped), 250 synth open_app rows per AW app (4750 total), 50/50 AC/AL mix for shared classes, AL-only for status. 1750 rows balanced. Same recipe + harness as r33 (text-only, harness-parity, 400 steps). 2/20=10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31/r33 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Data fix did NOT change deployment behavior. Diagnosis: M3AA11Y eval prompt already prepends AW app inventory, which constrained model to AW apps regardless of what it learned to call in training. Contamination was real but not load-bearing for AW SR. AC offline DROPPED full=12.00 (vs r33=9.50; both crashed by AC val containing same off-distribution open_app rows model now correctly avoids). AL type_match SURGED 25→37 driven by click 53→92 (AL data integration). Bottleneck is harness context (per user), not data distribution. Pivoting r36 to reason-preserving history in M3AA11Y
